in_sanskrit.name: रामकान्त
in_sanskrit.meaning: प्रसन्नदः काम्यो वा प्रियतरो वा पतिः
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is pleasing to look at or delightful, beloved or consort

in_hindi.name: रामकान्त
in_hindi.meaning: प्रसन्न दृष्टिवान् यादव यादव सेवक यादव
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has a pleasing appearance, a devotee of Yadavas, a servant of Yadavas

in_tamil.name: ராமகந்த
in_tamil.meaning: வீழ்ந்த விஷயம் வீழ்ந்த ஆவ்வை அல்லவால் காள்வர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has a beautiful form, one who is beloved, or one who is the lord

in_telugu.name: రామకాణ్ట
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has a pleasing appearance, a devotee of Yadavas, a servant of Yadavas

in_marathi.name: Ramakanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramakanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds the God Rama in his heart

in_bengali.name: Ramakanta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Rama
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramakanta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who holds the God Rama in his heart
